description.value: Neptune Seafood Restaurant is a well-regarded Chinese seafood restaurant established in 1997 by the Neptune Restaurant Group, known throughout Greater Vancouver for its abalone specialties and gourmet dim sum. The Burnaby location occupies the second floor of Station Square and carries recognition as one of Vancouver's Top Ten Chinese Restaurants along with membership in the Commanderie des Cordons Bleu de France. It is one of three Neptune Seafood locations in the Lower Mainland, supported by a suite of delivery partners.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Burnaby location of Neptune Seafood Restaurant at 2nd Floor, 4405 Central Blvd, Burnaby BC, with phone 604-565-8833; OSM tags (cuisine=chinese, indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=no) are fully consistent with the website. Multiple delivery partners (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Skip TheDishes, FanTuan, Panda) are listed on the website, confirming takeout/delivery availability. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi—are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the restaurant is in Burnaby.
OSM URL contains a typo ('resaturant' instead of 'restaurant') though the page resolves correctly.
OSM record contains no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website.
Second-floor location (OSM level=1) may be inconvenient for cyclists who need to lock or monitor bikes from inside.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Confirmed active restaurant with strong website presence, but no cycling-specific amenities are evidenced anywhere; the second-floor (level=1) location also raises practical concerns for cyclists needing to secure bikes.
